name: Dyn Mawr
source:
Finally, college! You followed your former best friend to prestigious but haunted Dyn Mawr. Maybe now you'll get an explanation as to why she ghosted you after starting her streams...should you save this friendship or let it die?

[From [url=https://eriettes-palette.itch.io/dyn-mawr]Itch.io[/url]]
